example.en: Critical thought is encouraged in all academic discussions.
example.zh: 在所有学术讨论中都鼓励批判性思考。

example.en: Students declare their major at the end of second year.
example.zh: 学生在二年级结束时宣布他们的专业。

example.en: Students receive marks based on their performance in assignments.
example.zh: 学生根据作业表现获得分数。

example.en: The health center provides free medical services to students.
example.zh: 健康中心为学生提供免费医疗服务。

example.en: Getting enough sleep is important for academic performance.
example.zh: 充足的睡眠对学习成绩很重要。

example.en: The botanical garden is a peaceful place for studying.
example.zh: 植物园是学习的宁静之地。

example.en: Monthly rent for student apartments starts at five hundred pounds.
example.zh: 学生公寓的月租金从五百英镑起。

example.en: Remember to lock your room when you leave.
example.zh: 离开时记得锁好你的房间。
